architecture_and_attention_serving.name: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for LLMs (Xiao et al. 2022)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Migrates quantization difficulty from activation outliers to weights via per-channel scaling — why W8A8 needs calibration and how it avoids the outlier-feature failure that breaks naive INT8 activations.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks (Xiao et al. 2023)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: StreamingLLM: keep sink tokens + a rolling recent window for fixed-memory effectively-infinite decoding; the canonical long-context serving workaround and its middle-context cost.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Ring Attention with Blockwise Transformers for Near-Infinite Context (Liu et al. 2023)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Sequence-parallel attention distributing KV across devices for >1M-token context; grounds the ring-attention long-context serving option.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference (Pope et al. 2022)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Memory-bandwidth-bound decode vs compute-bound prefill, arithmetic-intensity / roofline analysis, and the batching-vs-latency tradeoff that the roofline section builds on.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Insights into DeepSeek-V3: Scaling Challenges and Hardware for AI (2025)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: MLA KV-cache economics: DeepSeek-V3 ~70 KB/token vs ~192-328 KB/token for GQA models; 576-dim latent (512 KV + 64 decoupled RoPE). Source for the 2.7-4.7x reduction figures.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: P-EAGLE: Parallel Speculative Decoding in vLLM (vLLM blog, 2026)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Parallel draft generation on top of EAGLE-3 (~1.05-1.69x over vanilla EAGLE-3), integrated into vLLM. Marker that EAGLE-3 is now production-standard, not a preview.
